field: Supplementary Table S9. RNA-seq expression changes, GO enrichment and iModulon analyses following CRISPRi-mediated gene repression or tobramycin exposure.

description: RNA-seq after repression by g_atpI1-m2, g_accC1-m3, g_secA1-m3 or g_ftsZ1-m4, or TOB exposure, each versus the induced, untreated non-targeting control.
Differential expression analysis results of the effect of CRISPRi knockdowns or TOB.
Data for {{n_selected_terms}} selected GO terms across the four knockdowns, with separate Up and Down ORA statistics and contributing genes.
GO terms overrepresented among significantly upregulated or downregulated genes.
GO enrichment across the full ranked list of tested genes, and the genes contributing most to each enrichment (leading-edge genes).
{{n_modules}} PRECISE411 iModulon activities across {{n_comparisons}} transcriptome comparisons.
Gene FDR < {{DE_FDR}} and |log₂FC| > {{DE_FC}}. Up: log₂FC > {{DE_FC}}; Down: log₂FC < −{{DE_FC}}.
Induced non-targeting control exposed to 0.4 µg/mL TOB for 3 h versus the induced, untreated control; three biological replicates per condition.
Consolidated PAO1 GO annotations including propagated ancestor terms. BP: biological process; MF: molecular function; CC: cellular component.

One-sided hypergeometric tests (gene-set sizes {{ORA_MIN}}–{{ORA_MAX}}), equivalent to the original clusterProfiler::enricher analysis. BH correction was applied separately within each comparison, DEG direction and GO domain, across returned query-overlapping terms. Backgrounds were tested, GO-annotated genes: {{ORA_backgrounds}}. Query sizes (Up/Down for {{ORA_ontologies}}): {{ORA_queries}}.

Ranked GO enrichment used fgsea with BH correction separately for each comparison and GO domain. Genes were ranked by sign(log₂FC) × √LR from edgeR; GO terms represented by {{GSEA_MIN}}–{{GSEA_MAX}} ranked genes were tested.

Activities were estimated upstream using PRECISE411 gene weights. Condition differences were tested by linear models, with 95% confidence intervals and global BH correction across {{n_tests}} tests (q_primary). Estimates and q-values are preserved here.

DiMA identifies activity changes with q_primary < {{DiMA_Q}}, |delta_activity| > {{DiMA_delta}} and adequate projection coverage. Figure 6C shows all five comparisons for modules meeting these criteria in at least one comparison.

Up enrichment is positive/red and Down enrichment negative/blue (FDR < {{display_FDR}}). The smaller directional FDR selects the displayed direction; colour magnitude is capped at {{display_cap}}. Both directional statistics are retained. The background is shared across knockdowns within each GO domain.
Gene-level log₂ fold change, adjusted differential-expression p-value and nominal p-value for each comparison.
Knockdown or TOB treatment versus the induced, untreated non-targeting control.

field: GO domain / GO ID / GO term
description: BP: biological process; MF: molecular function; CC: cellular component. GO ID and GO term give the official accession and description.
Upregulated or downregulated DEG query (used for ORA).
Nominal GO enrichment p-value and BH-adjusted p-value using the correction groups described above.
Number of query DEGs overlapping the GO term.
GO-term background-gene count divided by the relevant annotated background size.
(Count / annotated query size) divided by BgRatio. Query sizes are listed above.
Normalized GSEA enrichment score. Positive/negative values indicate enrichment toward higher/lower transcript abundance in the ranked comparison.
Number of ranked, GO-annotated genes belonging to the tested term.
PAO1 locus IDs and corresponding gene names for ORA overlaps or the GSEA leading edge.

Count: term-overlapping DEGs; GeneRatio: Count divided by the annotated query size; FDR: directional ORA-adjusted p-value. Result records whether enrichment was returned; gene IDs/names identify the contributors.
PRECISE411 module identifier and original functional annotations.
Number of genes in the reference thresholded iModulon membership.

Estimated activity difference versus control on the native reference scale. Note that the sign follows reference gene weights and need not match the expression direction of the annotated regulator or its targets.
Lower and upper bounds of the model-based 95% confidence interval for delta_activity.
Nominal activity-test p-value and global BH-adjusted p-value across the {{n_tests}} iModulon tests.
